_comment: Human-reviewable overrides for the place resolver. 'reject' = not a place. 'extra_queries' = additional candidate lookups to surface in the review proposal. 'note' is attached to the place_string.

reject.Birth of child, Jane Marie Morgan: event description glued into PLAC, not a place

force_review.Berthelsdorf, Freiberg, Sachsen, Germany: Schwenkfelder exiles lived 1726-1734 at Berthelsdorf near HERRNHUT (Zinzendorf estate, Oberlausitz), not Berthelsdorf near Freiberg. Ancestry autocomplete likely picked the wrong one. Verify before accepting.
force_review.Norristown, Chester, Pennsylvania, Unite: Norristown is in Montgomery County (formed 1784 from Philadelphia County). Chester is wrong or refers to a different Norristown.
force_review.Amwell, Hunterdon Co, Pennsylvania, Unit: Hunterdon County is in New Jersey; the string's state is wrong.

note.Nieder, Harperdorf, Silesia, Poland: German Nieder-Harpersdorf = today Twardocice (gmina Pielgrzymka, Lower Silesia). Schwenkfelder home village. Confirm via GOV (gov.genealogy.net).
note.Langneundorf, Silesa, , Germany: Silesian village; German name. Resolve via GOV / Kartenmeister, then Polish name.
note.Schlesien, Germany: Historic region (Silesia), mostly in Poland since 1945.
note.Norriton, Montgomery, Pennsylvania: Norriton Township split into East and West Norriton in 1909; pre-1909 records mean the undivided township.
note.Rittenhouse Twp, Germantown, Philadelphi: RittenhouseTown (1690 paper mill site) in Germantown; not a township.
note.Amwell, Hunterdon Co, Pennsylvania, Unit: Hunterdon County is in New Jersey, not Pennsylvania. String is wrong.
